FAQ

Quick answers for clients

How long does a website take?

A simple site usually takes a few days. Bigger apps take longer. I give you a clear timeline before starting.

Will it work on mobile?

Yes. Every site I build is mobile-first and tested on small screens.

Can I ask for changes?

Yes. Small changes are included while we work together, and I'm available for updates later.

How do we talk and pay?

We talk on WhatsApp or email. Payment terms are agreed together before work begins.
